task.title: Connect product context to inquiries and human consultation
task.input: The existing InquiryWizard, chat-visitor-ui and model-events
task.accept: 1) Entries: product-card inquire-product leads to /[locale]/contact, and chat-product opens consultation; the data sources are POST /api/inquiries and POST /api/chat/conversations; after clicking, the request must contain a server-recognized product slug and must save an actual business identifier (E-16, E-31). 2) Consultation must remain possible without analytics consent; on network failure preserve the current-tab draft and retry with the same message ID; dragging/keyboard use in the model area must not submit (E-37, E-40, E-102); retain real GIF recordings for en/ru and narrow screens.
